 Order

This writ petition has been filed seeking issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the first respondent to adjudicate the application submitted by the petitioner under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 and Section 64 of the Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, wherein the petitioner is seeking for enhancement of compensation.

entities.text: Right to Fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Heard Mr.R.Murali, learned counsel appearing for petitioner, Mr.P.Sathish, learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for respondents 1 and 2 and Mrs.S.R.Sumathy, learned Standing Counsel appearing for third respondent.
The petitioner was aggrieved by the compensation that was fixed by the second respondent and hence, submitted an appeal before the respondents seeking for enhancement of compensation.
The first respondent called the petitioner for enquiry and the petitioner has submitted all the relevant documents.
4. Learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the third respondent submitted that NHAI has also filed counter.

5. In view of the above, there shall be a direction to the first respondent to deal with the application filed by the petitioner on its own merits and in accordance with law after affording opportunity to the petitioner and the third respondent and final orders shall be passed within a period of eight (8)
weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
This writ petition is disposed of with the above direction.
